answers.title: Undo a DNS change you already pushed
answers.section: Part B — Undo a change you've already pushed
answers.markdown:
## Undo a DNS change you already pushed

In your own zone (Lab 2), let git make the inverse change, then push it:

```sh
cd ~/lab/my-zone
git log --oneline
git revert --no-edit HEAD
dnscontrol preview      # shows the change going back
dnscontrol push
```

In the **shared zone** (Lab 5) never touch `main`. Roll back through a pull request:

```sh
python3 scripts/dnsctl.py rollback <your-pr-number>
```

It reverts your commit on a new branch, shows the `dnscontrol preview` and opens a new PR.
